utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’d start with the usual late-stage stuff—leaky faucets, loose outlets, and squeaky doors. If there’s room, I can swing by after I’m done running late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, those sound like good starter fixes. I can help organize the list and keep track of who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. First, could you check the drive’s power cable and tell me if it’s firmly connected?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the power cable now and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of the supplies for the repair drive. What do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I think we still need a few more tools and some basic repair supplies, but I’m a bit scattered on the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can make a quick list and keep it organized. Tell me whatever you remember, and I’ll sort out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can. What still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — we still need to sort out the pickup list and make sure we have enough volunteers for loading and delivery.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the pickup list and help with loading if that’s useful. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet, but I heard it starts in the afternoon. I can check around and let you know what they’re asking people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — please let me know when you find out. I can bring whatever they need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess—thanks. I can lend a few tools if they need them, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Gus. I’ll tell folks you’re willing to lend tools, and I’ll let you know if I hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone who needs the repair drive location, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send anyone who asks straight to you. I’ll also keep an ear out for neighbors who might need the location.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you come by at 3:00 PM?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep everything running smoothly. What do you want me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—please start by listing the repair tasks and who can help with each one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll draft a clear task list with each repair job and the neighbors best suited to help. If you’ve got any names or skills in mind, send them over and I’ll match them up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and make sure the plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. That helps—just keep it clear and I’ll be ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course—I’ll keep it simple and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what’s needed and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I could use hand tools and a working lamp—if you have either, I can tell you where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a working lamp at home—I'll bring it by. Do you want me to leave it at your place or the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point people to the signup info?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and share the signup info with folks I know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m glad you asked — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I may be a little late, but I’ll come by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries at all, Dane — come whenever you can, and I’ll let the others know you’re helping.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—could you help me sort the donations and make a simple list of what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can help sort the donations and make the list. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Faye. Let’s aim for late Saturday morning, maybe 10 to 12, so folks can still get in before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I’ll tell people to plan for 10 to 12 on Saturday. I’ll also check for any school conflicts and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I can help connect folks for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Start with the folks on Maple Street, then loop in Mara and Eli—they’ve both said they’re in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with Maple Street and then check in with Mara and Eli.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I just need to know which tools you’ve got and when I can swing by to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, a hammer, a tape measure, and a couple screwdrivers you can borrow. I’ll be home this afternoon, so you can swing by anytime after 4.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations—what spot should I note first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, let’s start with the community center on Maple Street. I’ll send you the rest of the locations as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the community center on Maple Street as the first stop. Send the next locations whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, did you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — could you bring the list of needed items and maybe a box or two for sorting? I want to double-check the details before we start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring the list and a couple boxes for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of repair drive are we planning?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We should aim for the basics first: tools, fasteners, and a few spare parts. I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can start by gathering tools and a box of fasteners. Just tell me what spare parts you want me to look for.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I’ve been a bit out of it. I think they’re still collecting supplies, but I haven’t caught the full update yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries—I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces too. If you catch the full update, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening today — I’d expect folks to start showing up soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out for people arriving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. That means a lot—if you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m headed out now, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’d be glad to help, I just need a quick reminder of what I’m supposed to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — please bring any tools you’re willing to lend and a few sturdy trash bags if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll bring my tools and a few sturdy trash bags. Thanks for the reminder, Leo!
